description: Sends a feature suggestion or piece of feedback to the AnimeHunt team on the person's behalf. Use when someone wishes the site did something it does not, or wants to report a problem. One sentence title plus optional details.

contact.description: Optional email or handle if the person wants a reply

details.description: What problem it solves, how it should work

title.description: One-line summary of the wanted feature or the problem

name: suggest_feature
title: Suggest a feature
